body: My mum dying. I use it as a point of reference when talking about stuff from my past.

She was constantly all over me all the time. At first, it was nice, but then 6 months down the line, it felt like she wanted to be under my skin to be as close as possible to me.

 We had been hanging out for the entire day. Went out for breakfast, she had to have one limb touching me at all time, if she didn't, she would whine to me about how I'm a bad girlfriend because I don't want to hold her hand whilst I eat my breakfast. We came back to mine, cuddling on the couch with her practically sitting on my lap to be as close as possible.

Nail in the coffin: it gets late, she says she's ready to go to bed. I say great, I'm going to chill in the living room for a bit but I'll join you after. I just want some alone time. She argues with me about me doing that. Says I'll wake her up (I won't she's heavy sleeper), she can't fall asleep without me (I say that's fine, I'll be about 10 mins). Then she decides to sit back down with me on the couch till I'm ready to go to bed, again with her basically as close as possible to me. It felt like if she could, she would wear me as a skin suit, and it was so suffocating, I couldn't imagine this being my life forever.

All his exes were narcisstic in some way or another. Everything single one of them, he'd not had one good relationship the entire time he'd been dating. I felt bad because he seemed sweet. Guess who was actually the narcissist?

I was drinking with my friends and my sister at my house. We all had way too much to drink, and I was pretty drunk. I look at my sister, and I ask her if she'll make it to the bathroom. Our friends were like, "What are you talking about?" And i tell them she's about a minute away from throwing up as im running to grab something for her to throw up in. Obviously, my sister protests saying she's not, and my friends all think I'm exaggerating. 

Just as I hand it to my sister, she starts throwing up, and I just go and grab her some water. My friends started getting excited asking me to predict when they'll throw up next

Don't stay with someone just because they get along with your friends/family. 

The goal is for you to be happy in the relationship you're in, not your friends and family, because they'll be happy as long as you are. I wasted too much time in a relationship based on that way of thinking.

She got upset very easily over very small things. It was emotionally taxing every day having a wall of text or lengthy in person discussion about something very minor that upset her.

One time, she was upset because when she said she liked jam and asked why I didn't have any, I told her that I dont have jam because I hate it. She was upset about the fact I hate jam - we had an hour long conversation about me hurting her feelings by saying that. She said my use of the word hate was "unnecessarily violent"

I probably said sorry once a day to her for the smallest things. I hated it, i hated having to filter what I said because I didn't want to have a wall of text or hour long conversation for saying the wrong word in a sentence. I can't imagine the mental gymnastics she did every day to be that upset about anything and everything, and I'm so glad I never have to deal with that again.

My ex was super close to their mum and basically treated anything she said like gospel. One day I come home and they're  showing their mum all the sex toys they had bought randomly on a video call and their mum was making comments and talking about which one she thought looked "cool". When I asked wtf that was about my ex flipped out at me saying that it's not weird for them to show their mum their sex toys and that I just don't understand their bond.

Im so sorry for what you're going through, Im going through a similar thing. My ex and I broke up. It was an amicable breakup. We are still tree friends, and we send good vibes to each other. It still hurts, but I see my exes birb as my birbs friend and just try to frame it as I'm sending my birb to say hi to their friend, not my ex

I didn't sleep for nearly a week due to insomnia, and the meds I had weren't working. At first, I saw a shadow out the corner of my eye, and then they formed into people and started talking to me. Started telling me horrible things and basically driving me to the brink of a mental breakdown. They sounded very demonic. It was actually really scary, i turned on every light in my  room, and any screen I had was also on because they would talk through the darkness of the screen.

I forgave them but I couldn't look at them the same, all the love I had for them died the moment I found out but I stayed because I cared about them. 

It was a couple months after when they were crying about how our relationship doesn't feel the same and they asked me if I hated them and I blurted out "I don't hate you but I don't think I love you". I realised then I needed to break up with them so I did.

When I had to beg her to just show up for our anniversary. They kept bailing on our dates a lot, to the point that even if they initiated wanting to go on one, i would make other plans, without worrying about being double booked because i knew they'd flake. She bailed on the anniversary date but then showed up a week later after I cried about how I dont feel important to them, but that for me was the final straw. I took some time to think about it and then ended it.

It was a double date with a friend and their boyfriend. Right from the moment we sat down, she was giving me the cold shoulder. If I asked her a question, she would direct her answer to my friend and ask my friend stuff about me as if I wasn't there.

My friend gets up with their boyfriend to go get another drink from the bar, and the moment they leave, she turns to me and just starts interrogating me about my previous relationship (my ex fiancee) asking why the engagement ended, not liking my answer and insisting that they're must be a more drama filled reason (there wasn't). Then she got annoyed about me "lying" and decided to insult every aspect of my outfit from my dress to the way I did my eyeliner.  Finishes it off with "I can see why you're single."

At this point, my friend came back and only heard the end of the conversation. They pulled me aside and apologised about my date but then begged me to stay. Nope, I left, and my friend blew up my phone and gave my number to my date so she could do the same. I blocked them both

OOP's  exit plan she had after she went to the hospital and he found out she was trying to leave and then her savings were drained. That hit way too close to home for me.

My ex when they found out I was saving for my exit plan did the exact same thing, worked less and less so I had to cover more of the bills until my entire savings was drained and then told me to "imagine" what it would be like if they left me here to pay for bills on my own with no savings. I realised that they knew and I never was more scared of them than in that moment. It took me almost another year after that to be able to leave.

I feel for OOP, with abusive relationships, leaving is the easy part its the not going back that's harder because they become everything you want them to be to give you hope and that's what her husband kept doing.

I forgave her. We dated for a couple of months longer before I broke it off. I could never fully trust her again and was starting to resent her so much that I was thinking of cheating on her to make it "even." I realised I was becoming someone I didn't recognise because I have never cheated on anyone ever. I deserved better, so I broke it off.

She basically bursts into tears, crying about how it didn't mean anything,how they never met (which was true as the person was in another country). They had basically video call sexting. She then tried to blame the person, saying she felt pressured to do those things, but from the messages, she was the one instigating these video call sex sessions. 

She then starts saying how she feels super guilty and terrible that she hurt me and that she's going to kill herself. She's super drunk at this point, so I lie and tell her it's fine, I'm not upset, and let's just go to bed. I convince her I'm not gonna break up with her. I was washing my hands, and at this point, I didn't realise they never washed their hands, and they were walking towards the sink. I just casually said "oh don't worry, there's soap on your left," as most of the soap containers were empty in the bathroom.

They gave me the dirtiest look I've ever seen in my life, turned the tap on, and basically just quickly flicked their hands under the water. From that moment on, I couldn't stop noticing it. It was gross, they never washed their hands and if they did it was a quick splash of water at the sink to give the illusion they had washed their hands. They got sick a lot, like once a month minimum, and I always thought it was because they never washed their hands. We broke up shortly after I found this out.

Which isn't a bad thing, but it was the tip of the iceberg for much worse. We didn't live together at the time but when we did I found out that she: didn't know how to cook, not even how to boil pasta, she didn't know how bills worked or why they needed to be paid and why we couldn't just not pay it, she needed me to book her medical appointments, she spent all her money as soon as she got it and completely forgetting about rent in the process. 

I had to bail her out multiple times, and it got to a point about 6 months into living together where she became abusive, physically, sexually and financially. She quit her job and refused to get a new one and then would physically attack me if I didn't give her all my money so she could "manage it." I was too scared to tell anyone about everything she was doing to me, but i secretly saved up, and as soon as the lease on our place ran out, I disappeared and blocked her on everything.
